label: The generalized Pareto tail
subgoals: Choose a threshold and record its exceedance probability
Fit scale and shape to the excesses over the threshold
Multiply the exceedance probability by the generalized Pareto survival

label: The shape parameter
subgoals: Read a positive shape as a heavy tail and a negative shape as a bounded one
Use the exponential form when the shape is zero
Treat a clearly positive fitted shape as a modeling warning

label: Return levels and threshold choice
subgoals: Invert the generalized Pareto survival for a return level
Pick the threshold where the fitted shape is stable
Report an uncertainty band for far extrapolations
